method: Direct visual comparison of original grayscale JPEG files fetched through connected GitHub repository, alongside the deterministic SHA256/pHash/dHash/correlation candidate screen and frozen Phase13 ROI metadata.

limits: Qualitative review is not radiologist adjudication and cannot establish different patient identity or rule out duplicate lesions acquired in different views.
